data.long_meaning: From the Greek word hattos, meaning 'gift.' In Greek mythology, Hattus was a goddess of fertility and abundance. In Christianity, Hatti represents the spiritual gift bestowed by God. The name Hatti carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hatti usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
